verdict.rationale: Angular's own site describes a fully featured platform with first-party modules for routing that work together with the framework [angular-docs-3], and community users independently confirm the official @angular/router package [angular-comm-1]. An early Angular 2-era complaint about missing router features [angular-comm-18] is a historical depth caveat, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party router documentation (route configuration, guards, lazy loading, data passing) and current hands-on evidence that integration is seamless.
